name: codex-goal-tools
description: Expose Codex's native experimental thread goal backend and goal-aware context compaction in Codex Desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Native Codex goal and compact commands
interface.longDescription: Adds local slash-command workflows that call Codex's native thread/goal and thread/compact app-server APIs for setting, viewing, pausing, resuming, completing, clearing, and checkpoint-compacting long-running task goals.
